refnamediv.refpurpose: Perform one step of the Durbin-Levinson algorithm.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [newphi, newv] = durbinlevinson(c) [newphi, newv] = durbinlevinson(c, oldphi) [newphi, newv] = durbinlevinson(c, oldphi, oldv)

listitem.para: Vector. Specifies the autocovariances '[gamma_0, ..., gamma_t]' from lag 0 to t.
Vector. Specifies the coefficients based on c(t-1).
Vector. The updated coefficients after one step of the Durbin-Levinson algorithm.
Scalar. The updated error after one step of the Durbin-Levinson algorithm.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Perform one step of the Durbin-Levinson algorithm. If 'oldphi' and 'oldv' are omitted, all steps from 1 to t of the algorithm are performed.
